id: conformance-14b-soup-v0.2 (dataset; adapter id assigned at retrain)
architecture: deterministic schema-validator floor (L1 type / L2 required / L3 enum-range-format) + LLM ceiling (L4 semantic-contract, L5 intent-vs-action). The floor is mechanical + infallible at serve time; the LLM does the reasoning rungs. v0.2 adds an optional STATE block to the evidence so REFERENTIAL contracts ('amount <= remaining balance', 'id references an existing resource', 'later than now') are self-checkable from (contract + state + call) instead of asking the model to bluff about invisible state.
status: TRAINED + CERTIFIED + OOD-DOGFOODED. VERDICT: do NOT promote — the exam lift did not generalize. v1 (conformance-14b-soup) STAYS the served adapter.

exam.note: tool-atomic held-out exam (144 records, L4 at-risk 16). v0.2 clearly beat v1 HERE.

ood_dogfood.note: 49 FRESH cases authored by an independent 60-agent fan-out (novel tools/domains, cross-adjudicated), distributionally independent of corpus_l4.json. The TRUE generalization test (the verifier-v2 lesson). Both adapters scored on the SAME cases.
ood_dogfood.verdict: v0.2 == v1 (identical 0.924/0.837); v0.2 has 2 MORE false-conformants (noise-level, n=8/class). The exam gain was authoring-distribution fit, not principle-learning.
shared_failures: sum_total (sum a list, compare to cap)
bounds_in_call (add args, compare to a third)
cross_field_consistency (index a string at a position)

results.diagnosis: The residual failures are COMPUTABLE-ARITHMETIC contracts (summation, additive bounds, string-index lookup) — exactly what a deterministic checker does perfectly and a 14B LLM at temp 0.1 does unreliably at ANY training volume. The classes that require world-knowledge/intent (conditional, mutual-exclusion, distinctness, referential-with-STATE) are already at ceiling for both. So more L4 training data has hit diminishing returns; the bottleneck is architectural.
results.decision: KEEP v1 served. Do not flip ROLEOS_CONFORMANCE_CONSULT to v0.2. v0.3 direction = grow the DETERMINISTIC FLOOR (schemaFloor in role-os/src/specialist/conformance-consult.mjs) to cover COMPUTABLE relational contracts — sum-to-cap, additive in-bounds, length-equality, set-membership-given-STATE — so the LLM rung only handles genuinely-semantic contracts. This is the deterministic-floor + LLM-ceiling design taken one rung further, not another finetune.

motivation: v1 certified 0.98 acc / 0.96 flip overall but L4 (semantic-contract) was the soft rung: 0.9 acc / 0.8 flip / 2 false-conformants of 10 at-risk. The misses concentrate in (1) cross-field RELATIONAL contracts (verdict depends on comparing two args both present in the call) and (2) REFERENTIAL contracts that were not self-checkable from the call alone (refund_charge — one of the two false-conformants — is exactly this: the 'remaining balance' the verdict hinged on was invisible).
changes_v0.2: Generator (conformance_puzzles.py): contract_group now fans out over a list `l4_violations` (one flip-consistency contrast group per clause, distinct pair_ids) alongside back-compat `l4_violation`; `_tool_evidence` renders an optional per-tool `state` as a STATE: line.

Build (build_conformance_dataset.py): loads corpus_tools.json then applies corpus_l4.json with override-in-place (preserves tool index -> tool-atomic split unchanged) + append-new. All v0.2 deltas live in one reviewable file; the canonical corpus is untouched.

Corpus (corpus_l4.json, authored by author_l4.py): 24 NEW tools carrying 40 self-contained cross-field RELATIONAL L4 clauses (ordering a<b, cardinality len==n / k<=len, distinctness a!=b, sum==cap, mutual exclusion, conditional co-requirement, in-bounds, monotonic tiers, currency-consistency), of which 5 are STATEFUL (transfer_funds, reserve_inventory, apply_order_coupon, promote_release, assign_seat) and teach the STATE-reading pattern.

Referential STATE-fixes (8 overrides): refund_charge, stat_path, post_channel_message, git_revert_commit, snooze_notification, paginate_rest_collection, secret_rotate_version, create_oauth_token each gain a STATE line carrying the operative fact, turning previously-unfair (bluff-bait) items into derivable ones. refund_charge stays in the held-out exam, now repaired.

dataset.exam_split: tool-atomic (the 14 exam tools never appear in training) — measures GENERALIZATION; the 9 v1 L4 exam tools remain held out, so v0.2 is directly comparable plus broader
dataset.audit: PASS (verdict balance 50/50, flip-ready 449/449, torn groups 0, evidence leaked 0)

recipe: unchanged from v1 — Qwen3-14B QLoRA, rsLoRA r16/alpha32, lr 1e-4, 600 steps, BUDGETER_BATCH=2 BUDGETER_ACCUM=8 (eff batch 16; the ~600-tok tool-schema sequences OOM at batch4), soup of seeds 42+1337, served llama.cpp --lora scale 4. Seq length unchanged from v1 (STATE adds ~1 line), so batch2/accum8 still fits (~88% VRAM peak).
target: Lift L4 to >= 0.97 acc / >= 0.94 flip with 0 false-conformants on the new 16-at-risk L4 exam, WITHOUT regressing L1-L3 (1.0) or L5 (1.0). Honest bar: even partial lift (false-conformants 2 -> 0, flip 0.8 -> 0.9+) is a ship if L1-L3/L5 hold.
build: python author_l4.py && python build_conformance_dataset.py   (CPU, re-runnable, audit hard-gates)
